meta.title: Covelet · A private start page you can verify, that doesn’t go soft
hero.h1: A private start page you can verify, that doesn’t go soft
hero.tagline: No account · Encrypted on device · Data stays in storage you control
hero.lead: Covelet is a Chrome / Edge new-tab extension. Nav and notes stay on your device with AES. For other devices, sync to your own WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). There is no Covelet product server and we don’t proxy ciphertext.
points.no_account: No Covelet account. We don’t proxy OAuth either.
points.local_aes: Nav and notes are encrypted on device. You can check permissions and where data lives inside the extension.
points.own_storage: Real cloud sync today is WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). R2, OSS, GitHub, GitLab, and the rest are Beta. We don’t claim “all five work” or rock-solid multi-device sync.
points.no_telemetry: No ads, no third-party analytics, no usage stats.
verify.body: This site is a static marketing page. It doesn’t handle your data, upload nav or notes, or load PostHog or tracking pixels. Inside the extension you can check permissions and data location (“Privacy check-up” from 0.3). Match these claims against the product and this site.
site_wont.body: No login, no email capture, no tracking pixels, no ads on your start page. The page only explains the product and sends you to the store.
storage.intro: The first real cloud channel is WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). Other channels are Beta for now.
storage.step1: Prefer WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). Everything else is Beta.
storage.step2: Enter only what the connection needs, then test it.
storage.step3_title: Set a sync password and sync once
storage.step3: Other devices use the same target and sync password.
storage.note: Saving is not the same as verified. Trust a successful connection test. If the test fails, you can stay local-only; local data is untouched. On multi-device conflicts we pick one whole record or the other. We don’t silent-merge, and you see which copy you chose.
migrate.disclaimer: Read these literally. Don’t treat them as shipped features.
migrate.bookmarks: Coming soon. Runs on device; works with bookmark files exported from the browser.
close.h2: Keep the new tab for yourself
close.body: No preset promo sites. After install you start from an empty desktop and add the sites you use.
